props.name: defaultPosition
props.comment: `[lat, lng]`. The map centre while either field is empty. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Disables both text fields and the pin; pan and zoom still work.

props.name: height
props.comment: In pixels, or any CSS length. Defaults to 300.

props.name: label
props.comment: The legend. A string is translated; `false` renders none.

props.name: latSource
props.comment: The form field holding the latitude.

props.name: lngSource
props.comment: The form field holding the longitude.

props.name: onPositionChange
props.comment: Called with the new position after a click or a pin drag, never for typing or a reset.

props.name: zoom
props.comment: Read once at mount. Defaults to 13.
